node.statement: Let epsilon=e^*:A->H^*({e};reals)=reals. For i_R:M->M times M, i_R(x)=(x,e), the right-unit homotopy in def-h-space-left-inversion gives mu o i_R homotopic to id_M. Homotopy invariance and naturality give i_R^*mu^*=id_A, while i_R^*kappa(x tensor y)=x cup e^*(y); therefore (id tensor epsilon) o Delta=id_A.
